_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 15:22 ET AND NOT CARRIED FORWARD: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, so the whole balance is settled and no good-faith violation is reachable - unchanged from the 10:23, 11:23, 12:23, 13:22 and 14:22 reads because nothing has traded. Equity and option position lists were BOTH queried live at 15:22 and BOTH ARE EMPTY, so no exit of any kind is due: no target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window exists to be reached this hour. ZERO equity orders and ZERO option orders exist with a created_at floor of 2026-08-19, so agentTrades stays 0 and the 33.87 level remains unowned at the last hourly that could have owned it. THE FINDING OF THIS HOUR IS THAT THE SPECIFICATION EXPIRES VALID AND UNREACHABLE, WHICH IS A DIFFERENT FAILURE FROM BEING WRONG. AS is 34.63 bid / 34.65 ask at 19:22:47.858Z on a 0.058% spread, last trade 34.645, +3.00% on the bid against the 33.62 settled close. The 33.87 limit is 0.76 below the bid against 0.74 an hour ago: the gap series across six hourly reads is 0.26, 0.28, 0.36, 0.71, 0.74, 0.76, so the drift decelerated for a second consecutive hour and bought nothing - the level is the widest it has been at every read including this one. The lowest five-minute low between 14:20 and 15:20 ET is 34.32, 0.45 above the limit, so a resting order was unfillable for a FOURTH consecutive hour. Filling before the 15:30 expiry requires a 2.20% collapse in six minutes. The specification is RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED for a sixth and final hour and THE LIMIT IS NOT RAISED for a tenth time. Both written invalidations are untouched at expiry: the 33.70 early warning is the session low EXACTLY, set in the opening thirty-minute bar and unrevisited in nine and a half hours of tape, and the 33.41 outright void is 1.22 below the bid and was never testable. The session high is 34.83, set in the 14:00 ET bar. Its 372.57 cost is 36.9% of the account, inside the 40% single-name ceiling, and it was the only claim on the cash. NO NOTIFICATION WAS SENT FROM THIS RUN AND THAT IS A DECISION: the last-hour trigger was discharged by the 14:21 slot at sixty-seven minutes out, which is when it could still be acted on, and re-sending it at six minutes would ping the operator about an order that cannot fill. Fired 15:21 against the 15:17 slot, four minutes late and sixteen minutes inside the 20-minute guard. The scope preflight matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY; every other account was discarded unread. The clock was cross-checked against the broker rather than trusted: venue_bid_time reads 19:22:47.858Z against a local 15:22 ET, confirming the -4 EDT offset.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings DAY-2 continuation - the 100% EPS beat of 8/18, whose gap faded and whose close held, specified today at a 33.87 limit for 11 shares
entryWatch.trigger: ARMED, RE-QUOTED AT 15:22 AND CONFIRMED FOR A SIXTH AND FINAL HOUR - VALID, UNTRIGGERED, AND OUT OF REACH, WHICH IS THE HONEST THREE-WORD SUMMARY AND THE OPERATOR SHOULD READ ALL THREE. AS is 34.63 bid / 34.65 ask at 19:22:47.858Z on a 0.058% spread, last trade 34.645, +3.00% on the bid against the 33.62 settled close, with the 34.83 session high set in the 14:00 ET bar. THE 33.87 LIMIT IS UNFILLED AND SITS 0.76 BELOW THE BID, AGAINST 0.74 AN HOUR AGO. The gap series across six hourly reads is 0.26, 0.28, 0.36, 0.71, 0.74, 0.76: this hour added 0.02 after last hour added 0.03, so the deceleration held for a second hour and it bought nothing, because 0.76 is still the widest the gap has been and the limit is 2.20% under the bid. The lowest five-minute low between 14:20 and 15:20 ET is 34.32, 0.45 above the limit, so this is the FOURTH consecutive hour in which a resting order could not have filled at any tick, and the forty-minute morning window in which it would have filled closed four and a half hours ago. Filling before the 15:30 expiry now requires a 2.20% collapse in six minutes in a name that has printed session highs all afternoon. That is not a live proposition and this row does not pretend otherwise. IT IS STILL NOT RAISED. This is the tenth and final direction the same refusal has been tested in. BOTH INVALIDATIONS WRITTEN BEFORE THE OUTCOME REMAIN UNTRIGGERED AT EXPIRY. The early warning is a trade below 33.70; that is the session low EXACTLY, set in the opening thirty-minute bar and untouched in nine and a half hours of tape. The outright void is a close below 33.41, which finishes 1.22 below the bid having never been testable. NO NOTIFICATION FROM THIS RUN: the last-hour ping was discharged by the 14:21 slot at sixty-seven minutes out, and repeating it at six minutes would announce an unfillable order to an operator this slot has already pinged today.
entryWatch.why: CONFIRMED FOR A SIXTH HOUR ON THE SAME THREE LIMBS, AND THE ANSWER WAS NEVER CLOSE ON ANY OF THEM. Limb one, the invalidation, is untriggered and 1.22 from the void. Limb two, the limit no longer inside the spread, is met on a literal reading and rejected on the same narrow one the 10:21 run wrote down and every hourly since has defended: a buy limit the tape has risen ABOVE is a resting bid rather than a dead level, and this morning proved that reading by filling-distance when the name came back through it for forty minutes. LIMB THREE ASKS WHETHER THE SETUP THE ENTRY DESCRIBED IS STILL THE SETUP ON THE TAPE, AND IT ENDS THE DAY MORE TRUE THAN WHEN IT WAS WRITTEN. The setup was a day-2 post-earnings continuation off a 100% EPS beat, entered on a pullback, with a higher low at 33.70 as its written support. 33.70 held all session as the exact low and the name made a new session high at 34.83. What has left the tape is the ENTRY PRICE, not the SETUP. KILLING IT IN THE LAST SIX MINUTES WOULD HAVE CHANGED NO OUTCOME AND COST A PRECEDENT. A kill here is the exact mirror of raising the limit - both are the tape rewriting a level struck in advance - and it would have established that a level gets withdrawn once it looks bad, in exchange for nothing, since the specification expires on its own terms at 15:30 either way. THIS SPECIFICATION EXPIRES VALID AND UNEXECUTED, AND THAT IS THE FIFTH CONSECUTIVE ONE. SMCI 8/13, UPST 8/14, SMCI 8/17, AS 8/18, and now AS 8/19 - but this is the FIRST whose level actually printed while it was live and re-validated, and the first not-forced six-of-six entry to die this way. Filled at 33.87 the 372.57 would read 380.93, up 8.36 or 2.24%. THE 8.36 IS NOT THE POINT AND THE FINDING IS WORTH MORE THAN THE MONEY. The 2026-08-18 rule change widened the execution window from forty minutes to five and a half hours precisely so an entry would stop dying of not being seen, and this one was published at 09:49, re-quoted six times without the level ever moving, and notified on with sixty-seven minutes to run. It still died. So the remaining gap is neither the window nor the notification - it is that nobody was at the desk in the forty minutes when the number was actually there. That is what this session hands the retro, and it is a sharper question than another hour of re-validation would have produced.

entryWatch.setup: TGT post-print gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - ranked second today, refused on item 2, and named in advance as tomorrow's better day-2 candidate if it holds
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 15:22 AND LOWER FOR THE FIRST TIME TODAY, WHICH IS THE FIFTH SWING AND THE REASON THE SEQUENCE IS KEPT RATHER THAN ANY SNAPSHOT IN IT. TGT is 161.00 bid / 161.20 ask at 19:22:51.969Z, last 161.14, +5.59% against the 152.48 close - DOWN 0.41 on the bid in this hour after five straight hours of climbing, and now 0.55 above the 160.45 the open refused it at rather than 0.96. Across six hourly reads the item-2 refusal has been paid, then regretted, then roughly flat, then regretted, then regretted harder, and now regretted slightly less. Six reads and six different answers to the same question is exactly why the rule is not amended off any one of them. THE WRITTEN TEST FOR TOMORROW IS UNCHANGED: a day-2 hold above today's close on lighter volume, with an entry struck after the fade rather than at the high. Where today's close lands is the input that test needs and it is now six minutes away, so the pre-close run has it.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD BECAUSE IT IS THE STRONGEST THING THIS RUN REFUSED, AND THIS HOUR IS THE MOST EXPENSIVE THAT REFUSAL HAS LOOKED. Item 2 refuses buying 9.7% off a session low at a fresh high on day 1; TGT has since made a higher high again and the entry declined at 160.45 would now be up 0.47%. The rule is not amended for one session, because item 2 is not a prediction that the day-1 high fails - it is a statement that this board does not have an edge buying it, and a rule that survives only while it is winning is not a rule. AS and TGT still differ on exactly one axis, day 2 versus day 1, and today is turning into a clean paired test of that preference: the day-2 name was specified and not owned, and the day-1 name was refused and would have paid. Holding both visible is what lets the retro grade the preference honestly instead of grading the one that happened to be written down.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, refused for a twelfth time
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD ON AN EIGHTEENTH TEST AND LOWER AGAIN, WHICH STILL CHANGES NOTHING IN EITHER DIRECTION. SMCI is 36.71 bid / 36.72 ask at 19:22:52.025Z, a 0.027% spread and again the tightest quote on the board, -1.87% against the 37.41 close and DOWN 0.17 from the 36.88 read at 14:22. The 36.72 ask is 1.52 below the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17 - still a better fill than that order asked for, and still not revived. Had seven shares filled at 38.24 for 267.68 they would read 256.97, -10.71 or -4.00%, the worst mark of the series and the eighteenth consecutive day the refusal has been the right side of the trade.
entryWatch.why: NOT REVIVED, AND THE REASON IS UNCHANGED RATHER THAN NEWLY CONVENIENT. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5: no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now six sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet. Neither is repaired by the price falling - a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst is a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst. SMCI appears nowhere in the live 8/19-to-8/26 calendar re-pulled this run. It keeps its place for liquidity alone, which is still the best here, and it is passed over for a name whose item 1 passes outright.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 2 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: UNCHANGED ON THE HOUR FOR A SECOND CONSECUTIVE HOUR AND STILL NOT A SETUP. KLAR is 14.64 bid / 14.65 ask at 19:22:50.199Z, -2.79% against the 15.06 close and one cent from the 14.65 reads at 13:22 and 14:22. Three flat hourly reads inside a red day is a second consecutive down day grinding sideways, which is not the same thing as basing. The precondition any entry here would need is a level struck AFTER the gap that holds on lighter volume with a written invalidation, and nothing in this session has supplied one.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT, AND ON DAY 2 IT IS DOING THAT JOB BETTER THAN IT DID ON DAY 1. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18. AS is +0.6% today after closing +3.2%; KLAR is -2.9% today after closing -22.5%. Two beats, two sessions, opposite outcomes - which is the whole argument for requiring that a catalyst be read together with positioning rather than counted on its own.

candidatesNote: The twelve carried-forward rows are bids from ONE quote call at 13:42:5x UTC and the six names added today are from a second call at 13:43:1x-13:43:2x UTC, so each row is a real timestamped bid rather than a blend. AS and TGT were RE-QUOTED at 13:46:2x when the limit was struck and both numbers are given on those rows. The field was widened rather than the bar lowered: eleven names reported between 8/18 and this morning and all of them are priced here, including the three beats the tape sold, which are the evidence item 5 passed on.

candidates.note: 34.06 bid at 13:42:55Z and RE-QUOTED 33.82 bid / 33.87 ask at 13:46:21Z, +0.60% against the 33.62 close - THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 33.87 limit for 11 shares, the second consecutive not-forced entry. Reported 8/18 before the open at 0.22 EPS against 0.11, a 100% beat, verified live. This is the DAY-2 continuation the rulebook names first under setups that fit, and the objection yesterday's open raised against itself - day-1 timing - is spent. Session: opened 33.85, high 34.47, low 33.70; the entry is struck on the 0.24 pullback off the 13:42 read rather than at the high. Liquidity real: 19.71B cap, 5.24M thirty-day average, 452,739 shares in thirteen minutes, 0.148% spread. Its 9/18 32.5 call cleared EVERY option gate at 13:45:01Z on a 1.94% spread with 0.672 delta and 7,857 OI, then quoted 9.71% at 13:46:23Z - refused on that instability, which is why the instrument is equity.

159.44 bid at 13:43:21Z and 160.45 at 13:46:23Z, +5.23% on a 2.46 against 2.25 beat this morning. Opened 148.285 BELOW the 152.48 close and reversed to a 159.94 fifty-two-week high on 2.16M shares against a 4.28M two-week average. RANKED SECOND AND REFUSED ON ITEM 2 - buying here is buying 9.7% off a session low fourteen minutes old, at a new high, on day 1. Named in advance as the better day-2 candidate tomorrow if it holds this close on lighter volume.

97.59 bid, +15.81% on a 0.39 against 0.32 beat. THE +8% DAY item 2 exists to refuse, and by a factor of two. Opened 93.97 and has not traded below it. Not a candidate at any price today; a day-2 or day-3 entry after this digests is the only shape that could ever qualify.

148.73 bid, -1.40% on a 1.22 against 1.19 BEAT. One of three names today that beat and sold off, and part of the live evidence item 5 passed on for AS: crowded expectations mean a merely-good report sells off. Not bought - buying the down half of a print is not a setup here.

373.44 bid, -0.85% on a 3.45 against 3.34 BEAT. Second of today's three sold beats. Also refused mechanically before any view is formed: one share is 37.0% of the account, so a single share is nearly the whole 40% single-name ceiling and there is no room to be wrong about size.
332.36 bid, -2.53% on a 3.07 against 2.42 beat - a 27% beat sold off the next morning, the sharpest of today's three and the cleanest single illustration of item 5 on the board. Not bought.

36.75 bid, -1.76%, and 1.49 BELOW the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17. Twelfth test, still marketable, still not revived: a lower price does not supply the catalyst item 1 wanted, the 8/11 print is six sessions back, and SMCI is absent from the live 8/19-8/26 calendar. Best liquidity on the board at a 0.05% spread.

14.62 bid, -2.92%, a second consecutive down day after an EPS beat of 0.01 against -0.06. No base has formed, which is the precondition any entry here would need. Kept as the counterexample to today's own thesis: two 8/18 beats, and on day 2 one is +0.6% and the other is -2.9% on top of -22.5%.

160.64 bid, +4.91% on a 1.57 against 1.44 beat after yesterday's close. Ranked third. Refused on the same item 2 ground as TGT: an after-hours print reacting the next morning is effectively day 1, and this is the first session's move.

92.83 bid, +2.16% - bouncing after an 8.66% drop on a 1.06 against 1.35 EPS MISS. A dated catalyst that resolved against the name, and a day-2 bounce off a miss is not the day-2 continuation this rulebook buys. The setup requires the print to have been GOOD.

29.97 bid, +2.95%, back at the 30.20/30.32 shelf whose loss this board wrote as the invalidation in advance - reclaimed from below rather than defended. Eleven sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead, so item 1 refuses it regardless of the level. The expired 30.59 limit stays dead.

76.09 bid, +2.18% on a 2.31 against 2.04 beat this morning. A real beat with a modest reaction, which is the least objectionable of today's fresh prints after TGT. Passed over for AS on the day-1 versus day-2 axis alone, and noted so the ranking is legible.
43.16 bid, -2.18%. Ten sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead and no second argument in the catalyst's place. Item 1 refuses it.
17.25 bid, -2.60%. Nine sessions past its print, nothing dated ahead, and part of the quantum complex that unwound together on 8/17 - the correlation the 2026-08-10 rule was written about.
6.94 bid, -0.72%. Nine sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. Item 1 refuses it on the same ground as the rest of the carried-forward board.
40.82 bid, -1.31%. Nothing dated ahead. Named in the 8/10 rule as one of the four that led hardest and unwound hardest.
8.65 bid, +0.12%. Nothing dated ahead, and the name this account closed at -14.0% on 8/6. Same complex as OKLO, so two of them would be the concentration limit rather than diversification.

7.58 bid, -0.92%. Nine sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. The 8.85 limit from the 8/10 forced entry is 16.9% above the bid - dead, and not re-struck cheaper for the same reason SMCI is not.

475.58 bid, -1.82%. One share is 47.1% of the account against the 40% single-name ceiling, so it is refused by an explicit mechanical limit before any view is formed. NVDA reports 8/26, six sessions out, and is the dated event this complex actually turns on.
27.25 bid, -4.35% on a 0.64 against 1.08 EPS MISS, the largest miss on today's calendar. Priced here so the morning's field is recorded whole rather than only its green half. Not a candidate.
